notes.text:
Efa Supertramp's first vinyl release - lovely pink vinyl with amazing artwork by tattoo artist OneSlutRiot.

This release features a re-record of one of Efa's most popular songs from her first album: 'All My Friends Are Freedom Fighters', now with adapated lyrics to our current knobhead facist PM Boris. The second song is 'Prosecco Punx' which is an activist anthem for everyone resisting this world's bullshit!
